What is Symbiote?

The Symbiote is the alien suit that bonds with Spider-Man before rejecting him and later empowering Venom.

Also known as: Alien costume, Symbiote suit, black suit.

entity.description:
The Celestials intended the King in Black to be a custodian of the universe, but Knull rejected this purpose. Symbiotes were used as Knull's weapons of war; however, after Knull's control over them had momentarily slipped, the symbiotes rebelled against their master and trapped him inside a planet they would call Klyntar after their word for "cage." Also adopting this name for themselves, many of them became a force of nobility and peacekeeping in the universe as the Agents of the Cosmos, while others remained a force of terror and hunger, often depending on the host.

On Earth, symbiotes have a notorious reputation due to corrupted symbiotes like Venom and Carnage, though Venom eventually shifted away from villainy. Recently, Knull returned, but he was defeated by Eddie Brock, who liberated the symbiotes and became the new King in Black. His reign lasted until his son Dylan's Codex Blade severed him from the hive-mind, allowing the goddess of death Hela to hijack the control of the symbiotes and turn them into her own army of death.

At the dawn of the Seventh Cosmos, the void god Knull was appointed by the Celestials to be the King in Black. The purpose of the King in Black was to look after the nascent universe, but Knull took on the role and then rejected its responsibility. Despising the Celestials for bringing light into his void, he rebelled against them and created the first symbiote to behead one of them. He used the head of that Celestial to turn this symbiote into All-Black the Necrosword, but the forging process caused later generations to fear both heat and sound.

The exact point in time when Knull first began creating amorphous parasites out of living abyss is unclear. While manifested on Earth in the 21st century, Knull stated that he first began experimenting with his powers and discovered he could do so while stranded on a desolate planet following the loss of All-Black the Necrosword to Gorr the God Butcher, bonding them to lesser creatures in order to transform them into predatory monsters. However, the Silver Surfer encountered parasitic symbiotes when he was sent back in time to before Knull had lost All-Black the Necrosword. All-Black the Necrosword, the symbiote dragons, Mister E, and the Void Knight are sometimes categorized as proto-symbiotes - experimental precursors to the parasitic symbiote species - rather than being symbiotes themselves. The Exolon are also a byproduct of Knull's experiments with the living abyss, being imperfect symbiotes that he discarded in the Exoteric Latitude. A more evolved "cousin" species known as the "Variants" also came into existence at some point; these Variants fed upon bliss from their hosts without harming them.
